description:
NC DHHS is seeking a short term (approx. 12 months) resource to provide development support for the architecture, design, develop, modification, testing, and implementation of the required changes to the EPICS System to consume the new generation of Electronic Disqualified Recipient System (eDRS) Web Services (Generation 4 (Gen4)). The modifications to the EPICS System must be written in CA Gen version 8.5 and be able to support any enhancements related to these required modifications within the core application. All changes to the application and its infrastructure must be addressed in a professional manner using DHHS' System Development Life Cycle methodology to ensure success, and to meet the business needs of the department. 
 Local candidates are highly desired and must work onsite at RTP location. 
 Expected Skills: Able to work without assistance; can provide leadership to others; able to manage complex work efforts; may have advanced education; may have deep industry experience. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
